name: P7: empty () splits onto two lines when the line overflows
note: LOGS-5799 problem 7 (open): when the declaration exceeds the 100-col limit, '(' stays at the end of the line and ');' dangles on its own. Breaking after '=' instead needs AlignAfterOpenBracket: Align + a low PenaltyBreakAssignment, which regresses 5 agreed styles (P2/P4/P6/long-args/ternary). No clean fix. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
